title: pvGenerateSpatioTemporalHarmonics
body:
## pvGenerateSpatioTemporalHarmonics

Adds a point array SpatioTemporalHarmonics (set as active scalars) whose value at point x and time t is the sum over harmonics of A·sin(k·x + ω·t + φ), with t the requested pipeline time and x in dataset coordinates. It produces analytic, time-varying test fields, e.g. to check interpolation, temporal statistics or FFT workflows against known waves. This is the old name of the same ParaView filter.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView 5.13 marks this proxy deprecated (renamed SpatioTemporalHarmonics, removal planned for 5.14); use pvSpatioTemporalHarmonics, which has the same behaviour and settings.
- The ParaView default harmonics are examples sized for bounds [-10, 10] and times in [0, 2π); give your own for other domains.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GenerateSpatioTemporalHarmonics`. Identity: `filters/GenerateSpatioTemporalHarmonics`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

Default values are only example values, that would make sense for a dataset of geometrical bounds [-10,10,-10,10,-10,10] and time values greater than or equal to 0 and less than 2*Pi.
